jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Manager, Machine Learning Ops Engineering - Fleet Systems
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Our work at CHIPCO is about making computing faster and easier to build for. As a member of the Applied ML team you will own fleet ML operations work from idea to production. You will pair with colleagues in research and product and be trusted with real responsibility early.

What you will be doing:

  • Keep dashboards and runbooks for fleet ML operations accurate and easy to follow.
  • Mentor newer engineers and share what you learn with the wider team.
  • Turn open product questions into measurable experiments and ship the ones that win.
  • Improve on-call tooling so incidents are rarer and shorter.

What we need to see:

  • Clear written communication and a preference for simple designs.
  • Comfort reading research papers and turning them into working code.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in Python or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience with Python, Kubernetes and model registries.

Ways to stand out:

  • Prior work on evaluation, red-teaming or reliability for learned systems.
  • Experience with distributed training or large-scale data processing.

CHIPCO is an equal opportunity employer. Base salary ranges depend on level and location.
